explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/172 with the reported positive resolution (OpenAI preprint, formal proof linked). In every finite colouring of ℕ there are arbitrarily large finite A all of whose nonempty sub-sums and sub-products of distinct elements share one colour. Allowing 0 or 1 in A only adds constraints for the prover, so it does not trivialise the statement.
